name: deep-research
description: A quality-first, stateful Deep Research workflow for Codex with dynamic evidence gates and controllable long-form writing.

interface.shortDescription: Quality-first research with dynamic evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Deep Research implements a quality-first workflow on Codex: it begins with diverse, high-information clarification questions induced from the actual task instead of a fixed checklist, persists research state, rejects low-value source padding, uses dynamic targets and information saturation, blocks premature drafting, independently audits original insight, supports charts and visual assets, preserves long-form continuity, applies article-type-aware Chinese or English prose editing, protects quotations and citations, snapshots the researched draft, and runs final fact checks.
defaultPrompt: Use Deep Research for this topic.
Ask diverse, high-information questions until material uncertainties are resolved; 3 is only the floor.
Deep-dive, visualize useful evidence, and write with a persistent research session.
